messages.subject: prior for group effects
parts: How can we set a prior for a group effect? In the set_prior() help page, it only talked about the prior for population level effect and the prior for the sd of group effect. My question is, can we set a prior for the group effect itself instead of the sd? If not, is there any workaround that can make a group effect always positive? Thanks!

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] prior for group effects
parts:
You cannot set a prior different than normal on group effects. See https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms/issues/231 for the related discussion.

Within brms' non-linear syntax, you can force them to be positive, however, by applying the exp() transform. See vignette("brms_nonlinear") for more information.
